**Coaching note (80 words max):**

You missed a forcing sequence after White pinned your h2 pawn. Look for pins—when a piece can't move without exposing the king, it becomes a target. Here, Rxh2+ sacrifices the rook to pull the king forward into a mating net. After Kxh2 (forced), Rh7+ drives the queen to bad squares, and any queen check loses to your rook on the 6th rank. The lesson: when you see an undefended piece pinned to the king, a forcing check might be a gateway to mate.
